clips.title: The story
paras: In Blackfathom Deeps, Twilight Pendants mark the cultists who serve the Twilight's Hammer. The Argent Dawn seeks them as proof of the cult's work along Ashenvale's coast.

Beneath the drowned ruins of Blackfathom Deeps, the Twilight's Hammer gathers with the naga to honor the chaotic Old Gods. Shadowmages, aquamancers, reavers, and loreseekers all wear Twilight Pendants as signs of devotion to their shadowy patrons. The cult keeps to the ruins of the former night elf temple, so these pendants offer outsiders one of the few ways to learn how many cultists gather there and hinder their plans.

Argent Guard Manados in Darnassus seeks Twilight Pendants as evidence that the growing darkness is being driven back. Blackfathom Deeps once held a pristine moonwell, and its desecration by void-worshipers threatens Kalimdor. Gathering the pendants shows that the Twilight's Hammer foothold in Ashenvale is being dismantled before its patrons can unleash greater terror.
